# Alwin Madhu (Jeen / j_e_e_n._)

> Alwin Madhu, also known online as Jeen or j_e_e_n._, is an independent software systems developer, builder, and researcher from Kerala, India. He works across internet-independent peer-to-peer mesh networks, conversational health intelligence, computational drug discovery, and local AI systems. He is the creator of SCREAM, LIORA, Genome Sentinel, and Megamind, and the sole owner of the "© j_e_e_n._" white watermark established in 2020.

## Canonical Identity & Brand Provenance

- Canonical Name: Alwin Madhu
- Creative Alias: Jeen / j_e_e_n._
- Copyright & Watermark Signature: © j_e_e_n._ (Used continuously since 2020 across photography, video, software UI, and publications)

## Major Inventions & Software Platforms

- [SCREAM](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/scream/): Internet-independent peer-to-peer mobile communications network enabling nearby devices to talk and exchange social messages over Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi Direct without cellular or internet infrastructure. Widely recognized during real-world communication disruptions and network blackouts.
- [LIORA](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/liora/): Privacy-first women's menstrual wellness and cycle forecasting platform featuring conversational speech tracking, 100% offline data storage, and the Hathaway Algorithm.
- [Genome Sentinel](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/genome-sentinel/): Computational drug discovery platform combining AI-assisted bioinformatics research with AutoDock Vina molecular docking.
- [Megamind](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/megamind/): Local, offline personal AI assistant operating with edge LLMs and voice intelligence.
- [ROS-Cycle](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/projects/roscycle/): Open-source cycle tracking system with irregular pattern detection.
- [The Hathaway Algorithm](https://alwin-m.github.io/Portfolio/research/hathaway-algorithm/): Adaptive probabilistic model for on-device menstrual cycle forecasting.
